reason: RM 2.80 a pouch is 80 sen more than the Whiskas I already throw in the trolley every week, and on my pay that adds up fast for a brand I have never heard of. I would follow the page and take the free pack, but I would not pay for more.
objection: My cat is fussy. If it sniffs it and walks away I have wasted money I do not have, and 'no pork ingredients' is not the same as a halal logo, so my family would still ask questions.
would_change_my_mind: If my cat finished the free pack and the pouch was about RM 2.20, close to what I pay for Whiskas, I would buy a few to try.
